acceptanceCriteria: A graph slot exists in the immutable index, is rebuilt deterministically from Git content, and every emitted row carries a reason naming the seed anchor and hop path.

The frozen retrieval evaluation is rerun with the slot on and off; the ticket closes only if recall@20 improves on the subsets where RELEASE-NOTES recorded the RepoMap-class deficit, with losing cases recorded.
Packet byte and result bounds, read-only behavior and abstention on missing anchors are unchanged and tested.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: slots are lexical BM25, cochange, pair/test, reverse-import, reference, sibling and documentation; there is no identifier definition/reference graph and no graph ranking, and RELEASE-NOTES records `context` below RepoMap-class structure-aware retrieval on 3 of 4 subsets at recall@20. Add a deterministic identifier def/ref graph over the immutable index and a personalized-PageRank slot seeded by the task anchors, ranked under the packet token budget, as an additive slot with its own reason strings. Prior art: Aider RepoMap; arXiv 2607.24882. Owning specs: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md, docs/specs/context-evolution-program-v0.md.
title: context: identifier-reference graph with budgeted personalized PageRank ranking
